_comment: The four museum wings and the pages that hold their set rosters.
Note the page titles: 'Museum/Fish_Wing' is a redirect to 'Fish Wing'. The
fetcher throws on a redirect rather than following it, so a page move shows up
as a build failure instead of an empty museum.

roster — and the Fish table has no museumSet column at all. crossCheck names
